title: sheer gray curtains
text: sheer gray curtains. I purchased these to go in front of a thicker black out curtain just for looks.  It matched perfectly in color - they are a medium/ light gray color and are what I would call a true gray - not a taupe or green gray.  They are perfect for my use.  I did toss them in a warm dryer for a few minutes to help with the fold and crease lines - but did end up using my handheld steamer too.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
